risk_factors: Readers may mistake modeled tax-share estimates for state payments.
Different reporting periods and financial categories may be combined incorrectly.
Political spending may be read as proof of motive or causation.
Tracker records can change as FEC filings are processed.
mitigations: Label every measure and period; separate aid, lobbying, candidate contributions, independent expenditures, and endorsements; provide source links, alternate estimates, full CSVs, and correction path.
reach_constraint: Public research POC; no claims of causal influence or wrongdoing.
assessed_by: Research assembly; human editorial review required for future status changes.
